integrity: Analytic proof with separately checked event integrals and moment equations; numerical checks are supporting, not an infinite-time certificate.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive speed, tumbling and relocation rates; uniform-time historical position-only relocation; independent Bernoulli velocity reversal; exact population moments. No density limit theorem or finite-sample estimation claim. Literature priority risk remains.
title: Velocity-reversal universality under preferential position resetting
